asset.name: BackgroundJobFlow
asset.description: The long-running operation pattern that begins inline, moves to the task registry, survives navigation, and exposes progress, cancellation, retry, and results wherever the user goes next.

requires.reason: Long work survives navigation by living in the shared task registry.
In-context progress is the shared notification.
The durable home for the work is the shared centre.
Pending, cancellation, retry, and stale-result handling use the one shared async contract.

rationale: The handoff is the pattern: work that starts in a dialog must not die when the dialog closes, and the user must be able to find it again without remembering where it began.
